panels.title: Tipik bir sürüş günü
panels.description: Aracın sürüldüğü günlerdeki medyan mesafe: sürüş günlerinizin yarısı bundan kısa, yarısı uzundu.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
days AS (SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('day', GREATEST(((($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'),
      (SELECT MIN(((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')) FROM drv))),
    date_trunc('day', LEAST(((($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))),
    interval '1 day') AS day),
dd AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')) AS day,
              SUM(km) AS km, SUM(kwh) AS kwh
       FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY 1),
daily AS (SELECT days.day, COALESCE(dd.km, 0) AS km,
                 GREATEST(COALESCE(dd.kwh, 0), 0) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z)), 0)
                   AS used
          FROM days LEFT JOIN dd USING (day))
 SELECT convert_km((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY km))::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "typical__$length_unit" FROM daily WHERE km > 0

panels.title: Şarjlar arası mesafe
panels.description: Dönemde sürülen mesafenin, dönemde başlatılan şarj sayısına bölümü.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Bilinmiyor') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0) SELECT convert_km(((SELECT SUM(km) FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date)))::numeric, '$length_unit') / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chg WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date)), 0) AS "per_charge__$length_unit"

panels.title: Hangi batarya seviyelerinde şarj ediyor ve park ediyorum?
Dururken batarya seviyesi
panels.description: Aracın durduğu (park halinde, şarj olmadan) sürenin her batarya seviyesindeki payı, 10'luk adımlarla. Sağdaki bir tümsek aracın çoğunlukla doluya yakın, soldaki boşa yakın beklediğini gösterir. Sürüş sonrası seviye beyan edilen menzilden tahmin edilir.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Bilinmiyor') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
cn AS (SELECT (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) AS c),
ev AS (
  SELECT d.start_date AS a, d.end_date AS b,
         LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, d.end_rated_range_km * eff.e * 100
           / NULLIF(cn.c, 0))) AS lvl
  FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff CROSS JOIN cn
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT start_date, end_date, soc1 FROM chg),
rest AS (SELECT b AS t0, LEAD(a) OVER (ORDER BY a) AS t1, lvl FROM ev),
r AS (SELECT lvl, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(t1, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
               - GREATEST(t0, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')))) / 3600.0 AS h
      FROM rest WHERE t1 > ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND t0 < ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND t1 > t0)

SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(lvl / 10) * 10, 90) AS level,
       SUM(h) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(h)) OVER (), 0) AS share
FROM r WHERE lvl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
